hebrewText: הֲ/תָצ֣וּד לְ/לָבִ֣יא טָ֑רֶף וְ/חַיַּ֖ת כְּפִירִ֣ים תְּמַלֵּֽא

tokens.bdb: to lie alongside (i.e. in wait); by implication, to catch an animal (figuratively, men); to victual (for a journey)
to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;))
something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food
alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.

tokens.bdb: a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.enLiteralWord: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.explanation: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.explanationEn: a village ; also a young lion

tokens.bdb: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: accomplish, confirm, [phrase] consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, [idiom] draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full, [phrase] have wholly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to fill or  be full of
tokens.enLiteralWord: to fill or  be full of
tokens.explanation: to fill or  be full of
tokens.explanationEn: to fill or  be full of
